document.h: Cover Letter – Senior Backend Engineer, AI Integrations – Hostaway

section.p: I am writing to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer, AI Integrations role at Hostaway. I am a senior backend engineer and solutions architect with 25+ years of experience building production services for integration-heavy SaaS and enterprise platforms, and I have recently focused on applied generative AI: integrating LLM APIs into products, orchestrating multi-step workflows, and making AI outputs reliable through schema-constrained generation, validation, and explicit error handling.

In my current work, I designed and implemented an LLM-enabled API workflow orchestration engine (tchatAPI) that executes complex multi-step scenarios defined as schema-driven JSON, with response memory, conditional execution, delays, and reusable sub-workflows. I integrated the OpenAI API as a managed request type to support AI-assisted steps inside operational workflows, and exposed the system via both CLI and OpenAPI/Swagger UI for reproducible execution and debugging.

A core theme of my approach is production readiness: contract-first APIs, deterministic validation (JSON Schema, XML/XSD), observability via dashboards and log analysis (including Kibana), and CI/CD with Docker-based environments. I have built and maintained robust integrations across heterogeneous systems (CRM/ERP/partners/search), and I am comfortable bridging stacks to connect AI outputs to customer-facing features with clear interfaces and maintainable operational practices.

While my primary backend experience is in PHP/Symfony, Ballerina, and Java, I have collaborated extensively across front-end and integration boundaries (including Angular/TypeScript consumption of REST APIs and WebSocket-based real-time features), and I am confident ramping up quickly on TypeScript/Node.js or Python to deliver AI integrations within your SaaS ecosystem.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience in applied LLM integration, workflow orchestration, and production-grade backend engineering can help Hostaway embed stable, observable, and valuable AI features into your product.

Yours sincerely,
Franck Delahaye
